question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is-**'spark'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given options, the **correct option **to fill in the blank is **'spark'. **
 
• The meaning of **'Spark': ***a flash of light that is caused by electricity.*

**​ Example: ***A **spark **ignites the fuel in a car engine**.*

Correct Paragraph__: *In order to fall asleep (1) __at__ night, strive to turn off all electronic devices at least 30 minutes (2) __before__ getting into bed. Allow your eyes to relax and take a break from the** (3)** __**spark**__ of a lit screen. Read a book, write in a journal, or write (4)__________ your to-do list for the (5)__________ day.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's understand the usage and meaning of the other options.
 
• The meaning of **'Stimulation'**: an action or thing that causes someone or something to become more active or enthusiastic, or to develop or operate.
 
 
• **Example**: *Electric **stimulation **can help to heal fractured bones.*
 
 
 
• The meaning of '**Energy**': *the power and ability to be physically and mentally active.*
 
 
• ***Example**: Since I started eating more healthily I've got so much more **energy**.*
 
 
 
• The meaning of '**Illustration**': *a picture in a book, magazine, etc. or the process of illustrating something.*
 
 
• ***Example**: The description was accompanied by a wonderful **illustration**.*
